log_dir.description: Directory where log files are written.

log_file.description: Base name of the log file (in log_dir).

workers.description: Number of parallel worker processes for evaluating alarms.

batch_size.description: Maximum number of alarms evaluated in one batch to avoid overload.

evaluation_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between successive alarm evaluation cycles.

evaluation_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for a single alarm evaluation. Alarms exceeding this are marked as error.

enabled.description: Set to false to temporarily disable alarm evaluation (e.g., for maintenance).

database.connection.description: SQLAlchemy connection URL for the alarm history database (e.g., mysql+pymysql://user:pass@host/db).

database.max_retries.description: Maximum attempts to reconnect to the database if connection fails.

database.retry_interval.description: Seconds to wait between database reconnection attempts.

database.pool_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a database connection from the pool (0 = no timeout).

keystone_authtoken.auth_type.description: Keystone authentication method (e.g., password, token, v3password).

keystone_authtoken.user_domain_name.description: Domain name containing the user account.

keystone_authtoken.username.description: Username for the Aodh service account in Keystone.

keystone_authtoken.password.description: Password for the Aodh service account (required, secret).

keystone_authtoken.interface.description: Keystone endpoint interface: public, internal, or admin.

keystone_authtoken.insecure.description: If true, skip SSL certificate verification (not recommended in production).

keystone_authtoken.cafile.description: Path to a CA bundle for verifying Keystone certificates (if not using system trust).

oslo_messaging_notifications.transport_u.description: Message bus transport URL (e.g., for RabbitMQ, Kafka, or others).

oslo_messaging_notifications.topics.description: List of notification topics to subscribe to for alarm events.

oslo_messaging_rpc.transport_url.description: Transport URL for RPC communication between Aodh components.

eventlet_executor.threads.description: Size of the thread pool for eventlet-based async execution.

service_credentials.auth_type.description: Authentication method for service credentials (e.g., password).

service_credentials.auth_url.description: Keystone URL for service credentials (often same as keystone_authtoken.auth_url).

service_credentials.username.description: Service username (may differ from keystone_authtoken.username if using separate creds).

service_credentials.insecure.description: Skip SSL verification for service credentials.

service_credentials.cafile.description: CA cert file for service credentials.
